# NewCo Studio

> NewCo Studio is a UK web studio run by Keith Bullock. The work is done remotely, UK-wide and online only. A small-business website of up to 5 pages is £299 fixed. A one-page website is £99. Website fixes are from £19. For a new website you pay half to start and half on sign-off, by UK bank transfer. A fix from £19 is paid once you have approved it. Prices as stated. VAT is not charged.

## Prices
- Small-business website: £299 fixed. Up to 5 pages (Home, Services, About, Contact, and one of Gallery, FAQ or Pricing). 1 revision round. Preview by working day 3 and live by working day 5 after the deposit clears. Half to start and half on sign-off, by UK bank transfer (£149.50, then £149.50). You buy the domain yourself. https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/website-299/
- One-page website: £99. One page with services, prices, photos and contact details. Usually a few days once we have your text and photos. Half to start and half on sign-off, by UK bank transfer. https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/websites-99/
- Website fix: from £19. Send the page address or a screenshot. Often a day or two. Paid once you have approved the fix, by UK bank transfer. https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/website-fixes/
- Prices as stated. VAT is not charged.
- Quote form: https://studio.newcopacks.co.uk/quote/ . Written fixed quote within 24 hours.
- The £299 clock starts once the deposit has cleared, not when the text and photos arrive. A one-page site is usually a few days once we have the text and photos.
